key_insight: UniHam provides 100,000+ DFT-computed Hamiltonians with full spin–orbit coupling (SOC) to benchmark AI models for electronic-structure prediction.
engineering_relevance: Learning Hamiltonians could reduce reliance on costly DFT calculations while supporting downstream electronic-property prediction for materials design.
method: Assemble complex-valued Hermitian Hamiltonians covering 72 elements and diverse crystal geometries and symmetries.
Benchmark two representative state-of-the-art models under a standardized protocol.
Evaluate reconstruction accuracy, composition/symmetry OOD generalization, and downstream property prediction.
evidence_signal: The benchmark reveals SOC- and element-dependent failure modes, substantial variation in compositional OOD robustness, and the need for spectral-level evaluation.
watch_item: Low Hamiltonian reconstruction error alone does not establish reliable downstream electronic-property predictions.
paper_title: UniHam: A Large-Scale SOC-Complete Dataset and Benchmark for Hamiltonian Learning in Materials
